Package com.lemarketjames.market

Class MarketControlController

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.market.MarketControlController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/internal/market/control") @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="sim.control", name="enabled", havingValue="true") public class MarketControlController extends Object
Test controls for the simulated quote feed (contract C4): set a stock's price, or make quotes stale or unavailable on demand, so pricing and failure handling can be tested without a live provider.

Only exists when sim.control.enabled=true (test environments), and lives under /internal, which the gateway never routes: like holdings' settlement endpoint, it is reachable only by calling market-service directly on its own port.
